caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a rectangular seat and a vertical slat backrest consisting of five evenly spaced, black vertical slats. The seat and frame of the bench are primarily black in color, with several areas where the paint appears to be chipped or worn away, revealing a lighter, beige underlayer. The front skirt of the seat features a decorative, light-colored scrolling design that runs horizontally across its length. The bench has four straight legs, also black with visible patches of worn paint. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or detailing. The artist's name, "EDWARD T. JEWETT," is written in small, uppercase letters at the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Spanish Colonial Mission Bench
